item.mng: čoγtu včir siddhi-yin toor-un sanvar dandr-a-yin qaγan
item.coloph: enedkeg-ün ubadini gay-a-dar-a kiged, kelemürči sakyalig-ud-un ayaq-q-a tegimlig belge bilig-tü orčiγulbai, mongγol-un kelen-dür kundga odzer manǰusri pandita-dur dulduyidču mati badr-a sagar-a sri badr-a toyin čorǰi orčiγulbai. Colophon of the Mongolian Petersburg Kanjur:
